overloadPatches.semanticRole: Calls the parent (superclass) class constructor from within a subclass's Class constructor, forwarding param(s) to it; must be called before This can be used inside that constructor.

discriminatedBy.rule: Function-call syntax Super(...param), valid only inside a subclass's Class constructor.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Used as a bare reference (no parentheses) within a subclass class function to access the parent (superclass) implementation, e.g. Super.methodName(...); evaluates to the object's parent.

discriminatedBy.rule: Bare property-style reference Super (no parentheses), valid inside a subclass class function, not inside the constructor.
